question: In which city was the first golf club of India situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first golf club in India, the Royal Calcutta Golf Club, was established in Kolkata in 1829.
 
• The Royal Calcutta Golf Club is also the oldest golf club outside the British Isles.
 
• It was initially started to serve the British community in India during the British colonial period.
 
• The club has a rich history and has hosted numerous prestigious golf tournaments over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Golf in India**

 
 
• Golf was introduced to India during the British colonial period and has grown in popularity since then.
 
• India has produced several notable golfers, including Jeev Milkha Singh, Anirban Lahiri, and Aditi Ashok.
 
• Numerous golf courses have been established across the country, catering to both amateur and professional golfers.
 
• The Indian Golf Union (IGU) is the governing body for golf in India, responsible for promoting and developing the sport.
 
 
 
• **The Royal Calcutta Golf Club**
 
 
• Founded in 1829, the Royal Calcutta Golf Club is located in the Tollygunge area of Kolkata.
 
• The club's course is known for its challenging layout and beautiful surroundings.
 
• It has hosted many national and international golf tournaments, making it a significant venue in the golfing world.
 
• The club offers various facilities and amenities for its members, including a clubhouse, dining options, and recreational activities.
